name: @quietops/server
description: Validated guarded HTTP and browser product slice for QuietOps.

scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build --workspace @quietops/contracts && npm run build --workspace @quietops/adapters && npm run build --workspace @quietops/agent && npm run build --workspace @quietops/storage && npm run build --workspace @quietops/application
